summary: EXIT area S1 batch (22-18 Task 3, D-16 area-batch tier), presented together once the EXIT slice audit, thresholds and cards were complete. Eight S1 entries, each a way money could be lost or a position left without a working exit under a realistic condition: AUD-EXIT-001 (RC-03, LOSS) every private (MEV-routed) sell, full and partial, V2 and V3, is sent with amountOutMin = 0, so a price move before inclusion, a raised sell tax or a passthrough chain (Base, Arbitrum) lets it fill for almost nothing (src/exitEngine.ts:351-372 V2, :378-407 V3, callers :870-876 and :1508-1514; card OD-14); AUD-EXIT-002 (RC-07, STRAND) when the first price quote fails the exit monitor silently never starts, so the position has no stop-loss, trailing stop or time exit until a restart (src/exitEngine.ts:1866-1873; card EXIT-01); AUD-EXIT-003 (RC-08, STRAND) the exit price signal is not a price: a fixed probe (the ETH buy amount reused as a raw token amount) is quoted, and the ratio of two quote outputs drives every exit decision, with separate unit, non-linear, zero-output and non-finite sub-claims (src/exitEngine.ts:315-345, :1866, :1869; card EXIT-02); AUD-EXIT-007 (independent, STRAND) exits that end with nowhere to go (V3 private not landed, unknown dex or fee tier, routine pause) return false without marking the position failed-held or re-arming its poll timer, after anti-rug and dashboard callers already cleared it (src/exitEngine.ts:1022-1037, :876-879, :824-830; card EXIT-06); AUD-EXIT-008 (independent, STRAND) dashboard force-sell and emergency-sell are sent as a routine exit, so a position whose routine retries are paused cannot be sold from the dashboard even though the pause alert tells the operator to act manually (src/api/routes/controls.ts:96-104, :169-177; src/exitEngine.ts:824-830; card EXIT-07); AUD-EXIT-013 (independent, STRAND) after a restart, and in the dashboard sells, a position is quoted and sold through the first V2 or V3 dex of its chain rather than the dex it was bought on (src/bot.ts:1940-1956, :1732-1734, :1145; card EXIT-10); AUD-EXIT-014 (independent, LOSS, candidate) an anti-rug exit is refused while another exit of the same token holds the sell lock, and waits behind any routine private escalation holding the wallet nonce lock, where its 60 s budget can run out (src/exitEngine.ts:832-835, :1483-1486; src/anti-rug/exitTrigger.ts:240-270; card EXIT-11); AUD-EXIT-015 (independent, LOSS) the probe size used for the entry price is not stored, and resume and re-arm use the current snipe amount, so a deliberate buy or a changed setting makes the monitor fire false stop-loss or trailing exits (src/bot.ts:413-422, :1948; src/exitEngine.ts:731; card EXIT-02). Already escalated and not re-counted here: AUD-EXIT-009 (S1, the RC-10 sibling sites at src/exitEngine.ts ~545/~556, await stx.wait() with no timeout inside withNonceLock), linked through ESC-PRE-02 resolved_items (D-23 b). No S0 and no immediate-tier item was found in the EXIT slice. The bot is OFF for all of v7.0, so none of these can cause a loss now. Nothing is changed in Phase 22 (NAC-13): each item is proven with a real-path test in Phase 23 and fixed in Phase 24. The operator was asked to acknowledge and say whether any item needs its own urgent decimal phase before Phase 24, or to stop the phase.
